newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Semicon to trade at end of the day -- bourse.
newsitem.headline: LG Semicon to trade at end of the day -- bourse.

text.p: Trading in shares of LG Semicon will take place at the end of Monday's session in one block because of the soaring number of sell orders received, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
The bourse said it received 26,000 orders to sell 810,000 shares at their lower limit of around 29,000 won.

"Because the orders were all in tiny blocks of five to 10 shares, the exchange felt the computer system would be overwhelmed," said a broker at a local securities house. "So they decided to postpone all the trading until the end of the day, when they would complete it in one go."
